kind: Volunteer then hand off: a task taken and later passed to someone else, a claim given up, and a volunteer whose task turns out to be unneeded

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Hi, all. Ana, you're a bit quiet. Can you move closer to your mic?

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: Is this better?

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Much better.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Quick sync before the release. First, the App Store screenshots. The current ones still show the old main menu, so they need to be redone for 1.4.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: I'll take it. I have all the devices on my desk.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Thanks, Ben. Next, the Spanish translation. The translator sent the new strings yesterday, and someone should review them before they go in.

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: I'll review the Spanish strings. I'm a native speaker, so it's quick for me. I'll do it tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Perfect. Then the press kit. Who's updating the press kit for the launch?

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: I can do that too.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Actually, I already started the press kit last week. I just need to add the new screenshots and the fact sheet. Let me finish it.

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: Oh, great. It's yours, then.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: OK, Priya finishes the press kit. Last thing: the App Store review is taking forever. Should we file a ticket with Apple?

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: I'll file a ticket with Apple about the review delay.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Wait, no need. I just got the email. The build was approved this morning.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Even better.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: So we can still release on Tuesday?

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Yes. The release is still Tuesday, at ten in the morning, Pacific time, same as always.

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: Should I post the release notes in the channel on Tuesday, too?

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Yes, please, once it's live.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Oh, about the screenshots. I just remembered that I'm out on Thursday and Friday, for my sister's wedding. Priya, could you take the screenshots instead?

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Yes, I can do that. Since I'm doing the press kit anyway, I'll use the same screenshots there. I'll do them on Wednesday.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Thank you. I'll send you the list of devices and sizes that Apple needs, today.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Great, thanks. And have a good wedding, Ben.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Thanks!

decisions.text: The release is still Tuesday at 10 a.m. Pacific; the build was approved this morning.

tasks.title: Redo the App Store screenshots for 1.4 on Wednesday
Review the new Spanish strings tomorrow morning
Finish the press kit: add the new screenshots and the fact sheet
Post the release notes in the channel once 1.4 is live on Tuesday
Send Priya the list of devices and screenshot sizes Apple needs

notTasks.text: Filing a ticket with Apple about the review delay (the build was approved)

truth.notes: Ben took the screenshots first and later handed them to Priya, who accepted: their owner is Priya. Ana offered to do the press kit, but Priya had already started it and keeps it: its owner is Priya. Ben's Apple ticket is not needed.
